message: Nothing was changed: 8 blocks cannot be mirrored for the counter spindle: 1 block with a rotary axis away from 0, 1 block outside the working plane, 2 thread blocks, 2 turning cycle blocks, 2 taper passes. No machine chosen: a word whose reading depends on the machine would refuse the run.

findings.message: G90 X40. Z-20. R-2. F0.2: a turning or facing pass with a taper (R): whether the taper changes sign depends on the cycle; write the taper for the counter spindle by hand.
G94 X20. Z-2. R-3. F0.2: a turning or facing pass with a taper (R): whether the taper changes sign depends on the cycle; write the taper for the counter spindle by hand.
G75 R1.: a turning, grooving or drilling cycle; its parameters are not mirrored, so the cycle would work on the wrong side.
G75 X30. Z-20. P2000 Q3000 F0.1: a turning, grooving or drilling cycle; its parameters are not mirrored, so the cycle would work on the wrong side.

G32 Z-20. F1.5: a thread or tapping move or cycle: mirrored in Z it would cut the other hand of thread unless the counter spindle turns the other way, which the program does not say. Write the threads for the counter spindle by hand.

G92 X29. Z-20. F1.5: a thread or tapping move or cycle: mirrored in Z it would cut the other hand of thread unless the counter spindle turns the other way, which the program does not say. Write the threads for the counter spindle by hand.
G0 X60. Z5. C90.: a rotary axis moves to an angle other than 0 here, or stands at one; turning or mirroring the path would need its angle changed too, which gEdit does not do.
G1 X40. Z0. F0.2: the working plane is not the one this transform works in (XY on a milling program, ZX with G18 for the lathe Z mirror).
